claims: Artemis II astronauts splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California, on April 10, 2026.
Artemis II crew returned to Earth following a 10-day mission around the moon.
Recovery teams retrieved Artemis II crew via helicopter to the USS John P. Murtha.
Artemis II is the first crewed moon mission since 1972.
Recovery vessel for Artemis II is USS John P. Murtha.
Artemis II splashdown time is April 10, 2026, at 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
Artemis II crew consists of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
